description: ROM Ali Input Sequence Pattern Matcher, Shockwave Spawner, Weapon Durability & Break SFX

routines.name: ali_motion_sequence_matcher
routines.purpose: Stateful 3-stage command motion recognizer: scans up to 12 frames in $FF1668 for Press -> Release -> Re-press pattern

routines.name: ali_shockwave_projectile_spawner
routines.purpose: Spawns shockwave projectile entity 0x16 at $FF1AA4 with elevation 19, orientation offsets 0x0084FC, and speed 0x800 via 0xE2D4

routines.name: ali_vdp_dma_enqueue
routines.purpose: Enqueues VDP DMA parameters (0x9D2FE, 0x9F00, 0x390) with interrupt safety mask SR 0x0700

routines.name: ali_weapon_durability_break
routines.purpose: Decrements weapon durability; ignores 0xFF; on 0 clears slot, reverts to Dagger ID 1 / type 0x0A, 90f toast, and plays weapon break SFX 0xC00269

routines.name: ali_exp_bonus_check
routines.purpose: Checks EXP threshold $FF0E3C >= $FF1A70; clears EXP and sets bonus item drop flag $FF0DBB = 0xFF
